claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: the query-map cached-bundle producer (evaluation/query_map/bundle_producer.py) can turn real cached OpenCaseLaw HTTP 200 envelopes into source-linked lex-query-map-bundle/1 initial+final bundles for every frozen question, and the accepted harness (evaluation/query_map/harness.py) validates the bundle contract on that input. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded. It does NOT re-open or re-derive any frozen bar. Both DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand; admission stays fail-closed. It does NOT claim the map helps a jurist; that remains the human product gate's question.
evidence_summary: Freeze discipline verified: all input digests (frozen spec sha256 187b0e54...) match before and after execution; no input drift (rehash_before == rehash_after for all 24 cache envelopes and frozen spec). Leg 1 (producer baseline): all 4 questions produce source-linked, duplicate-free, geometry-stable bundles from cached OpenCaseLaw input; harness checks all pass (bundle_nonempty, duplicate_free, source_urls_valid, answer_citations_constrained, counter_classifications_supported, geometry_preserved_after_enrichment, progressive_phases). Leg 2 (counter-evidence falsification): blanking counter_evidence causes counter_classifications_supported to go FALSE for all 4 questions, proving the counter-evidence contract is live on real rows. Leg 3 (source URL falsification): repointing canonical_url causes source_urls_valid to go FALSE for all 4 questions, proving source validity is not vacuous. Counter-authority yield measured honestly: 2/4 questions (corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule) emit zero counter candidates under the frozen marker_rule (norm_token AND limitation_token in title+regeste+snippet); 2/4 questions (rent-default, petty-theft-dismissal) yield candidates. Zero-cost claim verified: fixture_mode=True, latency_seconds=0.0, network_calls=0 (all 24 envelopes read from lane-owned response cache, no live network calls). Source-validity claim verified: all committed bundles have canonical_url on https://mcp.opencaselaw.ch/; leg3 independently confirms source validity is live. Claim ceiling explicitly respected throughout: no frozen bars moved, no geometry claims made, no journalist usefulness claimed, no universal-174k benchmark run. Minor: engine_record_path references producer scratch path but record content is preserved in committed tree with identical data; direction_version mismatch declared and explained. No repair needed.
